summary: Full backend + frontend testing of BIOXIC rebuild (YouTube-channel-style 24/7 radio). Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass (tracks, /radio/now live+position advance, /radio/heartbeat, /channel/stats + subscribe toggle, admin login + /admin/radio/skip resets position). Frontend: Live/Piese/Despre tab navigation swaps content correctly on desktop (1366) and mobile (375), no 'Maximum update depth exceeded' errors in console, radio play button + player bar + vinyl spinner + progress render, subscribe toggles 'Abonează-te' -> 'Abonat' and persists across reload (count 2 -> 3), Despre page shows BIOXIC + 4 social cards (YouTube/TikTok/Instagram/Spotify), admin login (admin@bioxic.ro/bioxic2024) works, upload-only panel visible with title/audio/cover inputs + skip + track list + delete, skip resets radio position to ~1.5s (near 0), logout returns to login. Real track 'Ce bunaciune (Remake AI Cover)' is in rotation.

integration_issues.issue: With only one track in catalog, clicking the track card does not switch player to 'track' mode (back-live button not shown) because current.id already equals track.id, so onClick calls toggle() instead of playTrack(). Behaviour is intentional per code (isCurrent ? toggle() : playTrack(t)), so the 'Înapoi la live' flow is untestable until a 2nd track is uploaded. Not blocking.

action_items: No fixes required. Optional: to allow validating the 'back to live' flow end-to-end, seed/upload a second track so Piese page has a non-current card to click.
critical_code_review_comments: RadioContext hot-reload loop (previously fixed) remains clean — no 'Maximum update depth exceeded' errors observed on any page or during navigation.
server.py is 1451 lines — consider splitting (auth, tracks, radio, admin) into routers for maintainability.

GET /api/auth/me returns 401 when unauthenticated (expected) but Admin.jsx logs this to the browser console as 'Failed to load resource 401' on initial /admin visit. Cosmetic; consider silencing with a dedicated whoami endpoint or treating 401 silently in the interceptor.
Pexels images in ChannelHeader/Live are loaded directly from pexels.com — fine for MVP but consider self-hosting for production reliability.
mutagen duration lookup in track_duration() downloads the audio bytes from storage on first miss; for large WAVs (37MB) this can slow /api/radio/now first call. Duration is cached after, so OK.
seed_data_creation: None. One real track 'Ce bunaciune (Remake AI Cover)' already seeded and in radio rotation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers radio sync, heartbeat, channel subs, admin skip. All data-testids used in the UI are documented in the report request and verified present. Only one track exists so Piese 'back to live' flow cannot be exercised unless more tracks are uploaded.
rca of the issue: N/A — rebuild verified working. The previously reported 'Maximum update depth exceeded' is resolved: no such console errors across Live/Piese/Despre/Admin navigation and across reloads/mobile viewport.
